name: Scissor
use_label: Free vector editor in your browser
one_liner: A free vector and pixel design editor that runs in your browser — no install, no account.

text.why: Installing or signing up for a paid design tool just to draw one logo or icon is a lot. Scissor lets you draw vectors and pixels together in a single browser tab, and says nothing you make is uploaded.
text.take: It starts in one tab with nothing to install, and your work stays on your device.
build: Vector tools with pen, shapes, live effects and full path editing, plus pixel layers painted beside the vector art. Properties, colour and type panels sit on the right, and your work stays on your device. A terms-of-use dialog appears on first open.

who.role: Small business owners and designers who need a quick logo, icon or image.

start.text: Open scissor.studio, agree to the terms and press 'Get Started'.

caveat: Source availability and licence could not be confirmed. The anonymous usage-analytics checkbox in the start dialog is ticked by default (you can untick it).

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: Scissor's first screen: a welcome dialog over the editor, with the toolbar and the properties and colour panels behind it.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
null in the JSON means not observed — never zero. The Markdown writes [unconfirmed] for it.
